Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary biological variable is the surface coating of the nanoparticles (silica vs dextran). While these are nanomaterials, they are treated as the perturbing agent in the context of protein corona formation. No specific child class in the ontology perfectly matches 'nanoparticle surface coating', so the broad 'chemical or drug treatment' parent is used. The study uses a mock plasma sample as a negative control to ensure specificity of the corona binding.
